gen-gf-warnes-fs-quicksand: Quicksand shapes its lowercase into soft glass bulbs, with endings that stop well clear of the stem. And Warnes, stretched wide with tapering ink strokes, makes a loud statement in a headline.
gen-gf-zhi-mang-xing-fs-literata: Literata reads bookish and sophisticated, its curves left unclosed. Over a longer run it stays steady, while Zhi Mang Xing, traced as if with one marker tip, is best enjoyed briefly.
gen-gloria-hallelujah-fs-neco: Neco reads dignified and authoritative, its strokes lightening gently toward the ends and its curves never pinching shut. Gloria Hallelujah is the comic spark, good for a couple of lines.
gen-gloria-hallelujah-fs-rowan: Rowan reads friendly and literary, with generous openings in every curve. Shrink Gloria Hallelujah and its comic bounce fades; Rowan is happiest in modest paragraphs, not page after page.
gen-indie-flower-fs-amulya: Amulya reads contemporary, its curve gaps staying generous. Indie Flower is the hand-drawn charmer, widely parted and relaxed, while Amulya does the quieter job, better suited to quick snippets.
gen-indie-flower-fs-recia: Recia reads sharp and authoritative, its modulation subtle until you look closely. Indie Flower brings the relaxed, hand-drawn warmth with no swelling at the joins, while Recia supplies the poise, pleasant in modest helpings.
gen-instrument-serif-fs-be-vietnam-pro: Heavy stems, hairline threads: Instrument Serif clusters its letters like rivets in a steel seam. Be Vietnam Pro keeps its curve endings far apart, and that openness is the pair's real hook.
gen-instrument-serif-fs-public-sans: Sharp and theatrical, Instrument Serif sets fat bars against fine threads. Public Sans backs it with broad counters and a hefty lowercase, giving the drama somewhere steady to land.
gen-irish-grover-gf-noto-sans-syriac-eas: Noto Sans Syriac Eastern keeps its curve endings well apart. Irish Grover, sturdy and organic with softly varied strokes, brings the fun on top, and the sans underneath stays out of its way.
gen-jetbrains-mono-fs-bespoke-slab: Bespoke Slab reads grounded and refined, with lofty lowercase bodies. Beside it, JetBrains Mono feels loose and contemporary, its fixed-width characters and parted terminals lending a code-style spark.
